html: † שַׁלְמָן (van d. H. -מַן) n. pr.m. vel loc. (cf. Palm. n.pr. שלמן GACooke299; Ph. n.pr. div. שלמן Lzb377 GACooke42; Assyrian Salamanu, of Moabit. prince COT Ho 10:14; n. pr. div. Šulmanu, v. foll.);—בְּשֹׁד שׁ׳ בֵּית אַרְבֵּאל Ho 10:14, Σαλαμαν (cf. also FieldHex. ii. 957);—dub., We Now think = foll. (and cl. ins. after Hosea’s time), cf. also Marti; others cp. Moabitish prince, v. supra; SpiegelbergZA xiii (1898), 120 f. suggests n.pr.loc., cp. Ša-ra-ma-na in Egyptian
